description: Audit pasted CSS for motion problems. Pass `css` (stylesheet text with @keyframes, animation and transition rules). Optional flash data you measured or know from the design: `flashes_per_second`, `flash_area_percent` (share of the screen that flashes). Flags: animation or transition of layout properties (width, height, top, left, margin, padding, font-size and similar, which force layout), paint-heavy properties, `transition: all`, animations or transitions with no matching prefers-reduced-motion rule, infinite animations with no animation-play-state or pause control in the CSS (WCAG 2.2.2), long durations, and flashing risk against WCAG 2.3.1 (more than three flashes in any one second, unless the flashing area is small). Flash rate from CSS is estimated from the animation duration and cannot see luminance change. Static analysis only.

flash_area_percent.description: Share of screen that flashes, 0 to 100

name: audit_motion_css
title: Motion CSS audit
